Package aor.proj3t.filters

Class TrainingFilter

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.filters.TrainingFilter
public class TrainingFilter extends Object
Filter class for training queries. This class encapsulates all possible filter criteria for searching and filtering training sessions in the system. It supports filtering by training area, language, duration, date, and text search, as well as sorting options.

The filter includes options to show only active trainings and provides flexible sorting by various training fields.

Example usage: 

 GET /api/trainings?trainingAreaId=5invalid input: '&language'=ENGLISHinvalid input: '&activeOnly'=trueinvalid input: '&sortField'=DATE

    • hydrate

      public void hydrate()
      Parses and validates string date parameters into proper date objects.

      This method converts the startDate string (ISO-8601 format) to an Instant. It also ensures that sortAscending has a default value if not specified.

      Throws:
      BadRequestException - if date parsing fails due to invalid format
